Build a validated claim card for auto$ctx$claim

Source: R/claim_helpers.R
make_claim_card.Rd

Constructs a named list suitable for assignment to auto$ctx$claim. The four operative fields — purpose, semantics, stakes, claims — are required and validated. All narrative documentation fields are optional. When they are omitted, Gate 0A derives conservative defaults from the declared purpose, semantics, and decision specification, and users can override those defaults whenever the analysis warrants narrower wording.

Usage

make_claim_card(
  purpose,
  semantics,
  stakes,
  claims,
  decision_spec = NULL,
  audience = NULL,
  target_population = NULL,
  setting = NULL,
  time_horizon = NULL,
  transport_boundary = NULL,
  intended_use = NULL,
  intended_non_use = NULL,
  prohibited_interpretations = NULL,
  decision_policy_rationale = NULL,
  human_factors_evidence = NULL
)

Arguments

purpose

(character(1)) Analysis purpose. One of "exploratory", "global_insight", "decision_support", "deployment".

semantics

(character(1)) Interpretation semantics. One of "within_support", "marginal_model_query", "causal_recourse".

stakes

(character(1)) Stakes level. One of "low", "medium", "high".

claims

(list) Named logical list with elements global, local, decision (e.g. list(global = TRUE, local = TRUE, decision = FALSE)).

decision_spec

(list | NULL) Decision context for G3: named list with at least thresholds (numeric vector). Required when claims$decision = TRUE.

audience

(character(1) | NULL) Intended audience description.

target_population

(character(1) | NULL) Target population.

setting

(character(1) | NULL) Deployment / analysis setting.

time_horizon

(character(1) | NULL) Decision / prediction time horizon.

transport_boundary

(character(1) | NULL) Explicit transport boundary statement.

intended_use

(character(1) | NULL) Stated intended use.

intended_non_use

(character(1) | NULL) Explicit non-uses.

prohibited_interpretations

(character(1) | NULL) Interpretations explicitly ruled out (e.g. causal claims).

decision_policy_rationale

(character(1) | NULL) Rationale for the decision policy / utility framing.

human_factors_evidence

(list | NULL) Human-factors evidence for G7B (user-facing audiences). Named list with fields participants, task_design, baseline, outcomes, analysis_summary.

Value

A named list ready to assign to auto$ctx$claim.

Examples

card = make_claim_card(
  purpose = "decision_support",
  semantics = "within_support",
  stakes = "medium",
  claims = list(global = TRUE, local = FALSE, decision = TRUE),
  decision_spec = list(
    thresholds = seq(0.05, 0.25, by = 0.05),
    utility    = list(tp = 1, fp = 0, fn = 0, tn = 0)
  )
)
